# M3 reuse acceptance rule: operating characteristics

*Generated by `node experiments/lib/reuse-rule-sim.mjs --reps 20000 --seed m3`. $0, no model call, seeded (beds/lib/rng.mjs). Simulation, not evidence about any gate. Monte Carlo SE at 5% is ±0.2 points. Floor ρ = 0.1; Deff uses ρ = max(floor, ρ̂). false kill = P(not served) at p ≤ 0.01; miss = P(served) at p = 0.05.*

## Rules

- `v1`: current: two-sided Wilson ≤ 0.05 at ≥ 60, early kill > 0.10 at ≥ 20, no Deff
- `a`: (a) one-sided 95% Wilson bound ≤ 0.05 (the ATTACK form), Deff ρ = max(0.1, ρ̂)
- `aE`: (a) one-sided 95% exact (Clopper–Pearson) bound ≤ 0.05, Deff ρ = max(0.1, ρ̂)
- `b`: (b) SPRT 0.01/0.05, α = β = 0.05, Deff ρ = max(0.1, ρ̂)
- `c`: (c) plan n = 181, c = 4 in effective units, Deff ρ = max(0.1, ρ̂)
- `a0`: (a) Wilson without Deff
- `aE0`: (a) exact without Deff
- `b0`: (b) without Deff
- `c0`: (c) without Deff
